cases.purpose: Qualify listener and connected stream types, legacy SS state labels, paths and independently decoded diagnostic queue lengths.
cases.oracle: Owned socket syscalls, raw proc tables, native iproute2 ss, and a separately encoded and decoded NETLINK_SOCK_DIAG UNIX dump.
cases.comparison: Fixed semantic result; raw netlink request/reply bytes and decoded fields, proc rows, owned identities and native/candidate output/status are retained for review.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-sockdiag-r1.py
O=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-observe-r1.py
C=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-network-controls-r1.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control
